race.description: Highview Accounting & Financial Pinker Pinker Plate Hcp
race.comment: SAPPHIRE SIREN (3) is a lightly raced mare who was first up with no public jumpouts at Sandown Lakeside but won well over a mile, albeit sitting handy to a soft tempo. She's been scratched a few times since and comes here off a 51 day let up which is interesting but clearly she goes well fresh and up in trip suits for a horse with plenty of upside. OCEAN BAY (2) had her winning streak ended by PARIAH PEARL (4) over this route last time out. OCEAN BAY was $3 there, Pariah Peral was $8.50 but the latter won well. OCEAN BAY should be better for the run at the trip. REALIKA (8) was $6.50 in the same race but didn't fire. Form prior was rock solid. SUN GIFT (1) was just a run first up at Mornington but did beat Suntora over this route second up which is excellent form.
